title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: Silent Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library
cards.notes: Utilize the basement level for absolute silence. It houses the general book collection and offers individual study rooms that can be reserved for up to four hours.
cards.short_summary: The designated quietest floor of the main campus library, featuring individual carrels and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The basement is the quiet/silent study level and contains study rooms, soft seating, and the general book collection.
cards.source_title: What is located on each floor of the library? - FAQ
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a valid Bradley ID; hours typically 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday.

cards.title: BECC Collaborative Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Bradley Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve a private glass-walled room for group projects. These spaces feature large monitors for screen sharing and ample natural light from the building's atrium.
cards.short_summary: Modern, tech-equipped private rooms within the university's newest academic facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The BECC offers private study rooms with high comfort and low noise levels, plus tech for collaborative work.
cards.source_title: The Five Best Study Spots at Bradley University - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Accessible to all students; rooms are highly sought after during finals week.

cards.title: The Study Steps
cards.subtitle: Olin Quad
cards.notes: Sit on the wide wooden staircase equipped with colorful pillows and cushions. It provides a tiered, informal environment for reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: An iconic tiered seating area in the renovated Westlake Hall, popular for its relaxed atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Westlake's study steps allow for an unusual but comfortable study space with pillows and cushions.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; generally quieter in the late afternoon.

cards.title: The Atrium
cards.subtitle: 915 N Elmwood Ave
cards.notes: Work at the tables near the large floor-to-ceiling windows. This spot offers high visibility and easy access to food options on the main level.
cards.short_summary: A bright, high-traffic study area on the main level of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium is a popular location on the main level of the Student Center with large windows and natural light.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces On and Around Bradley - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open late; food options available until 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Low-Stress Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 1st Floor
cards.notes: Visit this space for a mental break or low-intensity studying. It is designed to be a safe, welcoming environment for students to decompress.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated wellness-focused space within the library for relaxation and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Breathing Room is located on the main floor of the library as a space for students to relax and connect.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during regular library hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: The Veranda
cards.subtitle: 816 N Tobias Ln
cards.notes: Study outdoors on the third-floor veranda overlooking the quad. This spot offers one of the best elevated views of the campus landscape.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor balcony space providing a quiet, scenic environment for fair-weather studying.
cards.evidence_claim: A banquet room on the third floor accesses a veranda with views of the quad.
cards.access_notes: Access may be limited during private alumni events; check building schedule.

cards.title: Jerry's Juice Bar Lounge
cards.subtitle: 819 N Haussler Ln
cards.notes: Grab a smoothie and use the lounge seating for a post-workout study session. It's a high-energy spot with frequent student traffic.
cards.short_summary: A casual lounge area within the recreation center, ideal for quick tasks between gym sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Jerry's juice bar is located in the facility and offers snack options, making it a favorite stop when heading to class.
cards.source_title: Tour: Markin Family Student Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: Open during Markin Center hours; requires Bradley ID for entry.

cards.title: Individual Quiet Pods
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 1st Floor
cards.notes: Claim one of the semi-enclosed pods for focused individual work. These provide a visual barrier from the main floor's activity.
cards.short_summary: Semi-private individual seating units designed for distraction-free studying on the main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The main floor of the library features quiet pods and soft seating.
cards.source_title: What is located on each floor of the library? - FAQ
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library hours.

cards.title: Inclusive Study Space
cards.subtitle: Michel Student Center Room 11
cards.notes: Study in a welcoming environment that offers comfy seats and office materials. It's a hub for community and advocacy that also supports quiet work.
cards.short_summary: A safe-space lounge in the student center that welcomes students for both social connection and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors are welcome to study, play games, and relax in the Kaleidoscope Center.
cards.source_title: Office of Campus Culture & Climate - Bradley University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday with specific afternoon hours; check website for current schedule.

cards.title: The Music Library
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study surrounded by thousands of music scores and recordings. This specialized collection area offers a unique, academic atmosphere on the library's second floor.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library branch within the main library, recently relocated to the second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: In 2025, the Music Resource Center was moved into a new dedicated space on the second floor of the library.
cards.source_title: Music Resource Center - Bradley University Music History
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; features listening facilities and computer areas.
